visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand pouring clear liquid into a metal pot filled with cooking clams and garlic. Then, a wooden ladle lifts several cooked clams from a creamy, orange-colored soup base. The lighting is bright and warm, typical of a professional studio or restaurant. (2) A man with short dark hair wearing a grey hoodie appears. He holds a small white bowl of food and points at it while smiling. Then he takes a bite with a plastic spoon, looking extremely satisfied. The background shows a dimly lit indoor restaurant. (3) The scene shifts back to the pot, showing the vibrant orange broth. A small bowl of red and green chili sauce is shown, being stirred with a spoon. Yellow text overlays appear on the screen to highlight specific features of the dish. (4) The man holds up a brown book or menu that has a logo and a picture of a hotpot on the cover. He moves it closer to the camera and then pulls it away to reveal his face, maintaining an enthusiastic expression. (5) An exterior shot of the restaurant at night shows a large glowing sign and various potted plants at the entrance. The camera then moves through the glass doors into a well-lit, modern interior with dining tables. (6) A waitress in a black and white striped shirt is seen preparing a hotpot at a counter. She smiles at the camera while stirring. Various ingredients like vegetables and meat are visible in bowls next to her on the counter. (7) A sequence of shots shows the cooking process: oil and garlic are sautéed, a large bowl of clams is poured in, followed by a rich orange broth. The camera uses close-ups to emphasize the textures and colors of the ingredients. (8) A wooden lid is lifted from the pot, releasing a cloud of steam. Inside, the clams have opened and are submerged in the bubbling creamy soup. The man is shown again, drinking the soup directly from a bowl and looking amazed. (9) The man eats a large, juicy clam using chopsticks. More variety-show style text appears on the screen, like 'Juicy' and 'Fat and sweet.' He continues to eat with high energy, looking directly into the camera. (10) A basket of fresh vegetables including cabbage and carrots is shown. Sliced salmon is then dipped into the boiling pot. The man demonstrates the 'correct way' to eat by putting chili sauce on a plate and dipping the fish into it. (11) The waitress prepares porridge in the remaining broth by adding a bowl of white rice, mashed pumpkin, beaten eggs, and chopped scallions. She stirs the mixture continuously until it becomes thick and yellow. (12) The man holds a bowl of the finished porridge topped with green onions and seaweed. He eats it with a spoon, closing his eyes in delight. Animated heart and star graphics surround him to indicate his intense enjoyment of the food. (13) The video concludes with the man showing the empty restaurant space and then standing outside the restaurant again, gesturing towards the entrance to invite viewers. The editing is fast-paced with many cuts and transitions.

(7) A percussive pouring sound occurs as rice is added to the pot. A rapid whisking or stirring sound follows, creating a repetitive rhythmic texture. The narrator's voice remains dominant and assertive, commanding the listener's attention with a friendly, professional tone.
